set.rappels: One to three short single-rope rappels off natural anchors down the south gullies to the Eye Col; parties continuing to West Twin Needle exit by the Himmelhorn-West Twin Needle notch on two double-rope rappels
set.rappel_count_note: Reversing the route takes one to three short single-rope rappels off horns and slings, depending on snow cover and the gully taken; their positions are not published. Two 60 m ropes are recommended because the enchainment exit via the Himmelhorn-West Twin Needle notch needs two double-rope rappels.
set.descent: Reverse the route: downclimb and make short rappels down the south gullies to the Eye Col, then descend into Crescent Creek Basin.
